questions.question: What is the primary advantage of React 19 Actions over manual async state handling?
options: They automatically manage pending states, optimistic updates, and error handling
They force the entire application into client-side rendering
They eliminate the need for JavaScript in the browser
They replace CSS animations with WebGL
questions.explanation: React Actions streamline asynchronous transactions by natively coordinating pending states, error boundaries, and optimistic UI transitions.

questions.question: When designing an offline-first learning system, where should student progress first be committed?
options: In local fast-access storage with background synchronizer queue to the backend
Strictly in server session cookies without client cache
questions.explanation: An offline-first design commits immediately to resilient local storage (IndexedDB/localStorage) and dispatches an asynchronous reconciliation queue to the cloud database.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of looking up a lesson bookmark in a JavaScript Set or Hash Map?
questions.explanation: Sets and Hash Maps use bucketed hash indexing providing O(1) average constant-time lookups.
